description: This file is a shell script used to test Git LFS integration with Perforce repositories. It contains test cases for cloning repositories, verifying files are stored in Git LFS based on size, extension, and compression thresholds, and managing .gitattributes configurations.

methods.name: test_file_in_lfs
methods.description: Verifies that a specific file has been stored in Git LFS based on expected size and content.

methods.name: test_file_count_in_dir
methods.description: Checks the number of files in a given directory.
